Public test CSD that SAT publishes for developers (ESCUELA KEMPER URGATE SA DE CV,
RFC EKU9003173C9). The private key password is `12345678a`. It is not valid for
real invoices.

`../cadenas-sat.json` holds the cadena original of each case in `../../cfdi-cases.ts`,
produced by applying SAT's `cadenaoriginal_4_0.xslt` to the signed XML. The same
XML also validates against `cfdv40.xsd`.
